scripts.dev: concurrently -n WORKER,CLIENT -c auto "npm run worker" "npm run client"
scripts.dev:cloudflare: concurrently -n WORKER,CLIENT -c auto "npm run worker" "npm run client"
scripts.build: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix worker
scripts.build:cloudflare: npm run build --prefix client && npm run build --prefix worker
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --prefix client && npm run typecheck --prefix worker
scripts.typecheck:cloudflare: npm run typecheck --prefix client && npm run typecheck --prefix worker
scripts.setup: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix worker && npm run db:generate && npm run db:migrate
